experiment.title: mAbX23 Fab binding human soluble IL-6 receptor
experiment.path: Root/01 - Research/IL6R Program/Analytics/Biosensor/mAbX23 Fab binding IL6R

background.text: mAbX23 is a monoclonal antibody targeting human IL-6 receptor (IL-6R). It is designed as a non-blocking control antibody for receptor occupancy studies. Literature reports binding affinity in the low nanomolar range (~3.5 nM).

objectives: Measure binding affinity of mAbX23 Fab to human soluble IL-6R at pH 7.4
Compare dissociation rates versus reference antibody Tocilizumab

method.description: SPR-based kinetic analysis using standard capture method. Association and dissociation phases monitored across multiple concentrations. Data fitted using 1:1 binding model where applicable.

results.notes: Association rates could not be reliably determined due to avidity effects.

conclusion.summary: mAbX23 Fab binds IL-6R with moderate affinity (~1.2 nM) but shows significantly faster dissociation compared to Tocilizumab. Reduced binding stability suggests weaker receptor engagement.
keyFindings: 5x weaker affinity compared to reference antibody
